browser.title: Browse the existing product
browser.missing: No HTTP MCP is configured in the browser-use category. Add a browser connection or explicitly choose code-only design.
browser.codeOnlyHint: This turn will not inspect the existing interface. The design will state this limitation.
browser.loginHint: Sign in to the website in the remote browser and select Allow AI control on its guide page. A connection check does not verify login. The design instructions require the AI to observe the existing UI without saving, submitting, deleting, or modifying business data, then use the code and observations to create a high-fidelity prototype.
browser.checkPassed: The executor connected to the MCP and found the required browser tools. Website login and human authorization have not been verified.
browser.checkFailed: Connection failed or required browser tools are missing. Check executor connectivity, the token and browser service, or explicitly choose code-only design.
browser.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the configuration, capability management permissions and key service.
browser.loadFailed: Could not load browser MCP configuration.
browser.unavailable: The selected browser MCP was deleted, moved out of the category or no longer supports HTTP. Select another connection.
browser.name: Connection name
browser.invalidUrl: Enter an HTTP or HTTPS URL without embedded credentials.
browser.categoryHint: Saving automatically assigns the {{category}} category and encrypts the token using the existing key service.

page.title: PRD design workbench
page.loadFailed: Failed to load the PRD design
page.legacyMode: This work item still uses its original delivery path
page.legacyModeHint: Delivery only enforces the confirmed version after you choose PRD-driven delivery when confirming; until then the existing delivery flow is unaffected.

entry.title: PRD design
entry.noDesign: This work item has no PRD design yet. Open the workbench to start generating one.

versions.title: Version history
versions.empty: No versions yet; start a generation on the right
versions.immutable: A confirmed version cannot be modified

conversation.inputHint: Describe a change or paste a screenshot…
conversation.previewFailed: This design could not be rendered. The previous preview is retained. Ask the employee to correct the design.
conversation.progressFailed: Execution updates are temporarily unavailable. Retrying; execution may still be running.
conversation.previewUpdated: The design preview is updated. Review it on the right and continue with your feedback.
conversation.working: Design in progress. Execution updates will appear here…
conversation.agentRequired: Select a digital employee to generate and revise the PRD through its client executor.
conversation.failed: The design conversation request failed. Please retry.
conversation.title: Design conversation

preview.navigationBlocked: This link has no prototype page yet
preview.navigationHint: Your current preview is preserved. Describe the missing page in the design conversation. Use Reset preview in the upper right to restore its initial state.
preview.selectHint: Click a button, text or any element in the prototype, then describe the change on the left.
preview.title: PRD document and prototype
preview.noVersion: Describe your requirements or add screenshots on the left. The design will appear here automatically.

target.manualHint: Configure the target project manually. No repository probe is needed. Delivery uses the existing repository branch configuration.
target.directoryHint: Enter a repository-relative path, such as frontend. Use . for the repository root.
target.notesPlaceholder: For example, React, Vite, Ant Design, project conventions, or existing page styles.
target.repoLoadFailed: Failed to load repositories. Refresh and retry.
target.title: Target frontend project
target.hint: Identified as repo + commit + application root. One repo may contain several applications; when the probe cannot reliably tell them apart you choose, and the system never picks a default for you.
target.noProfile: No frontend application has been probed in this repo yet; run a probe from the repo detail first
target.multipleCandidatesHint: The probe cannot reliably distinguish them; use the profile evidence to pick the application to actually deliver into.
target.saveFailed: Failed to select the target project
target.discovering: Discovering frontend projects in this workspace
target.discoveryFailed: Automatic discovery failed. Select a repository and retry the probe.
target.probeFailed: The repository probe failed. Check access and retry.

confirm.targetChanged: This version needs updated target project information
confirm.targetChangedHint: The project was not selected when this version was saved, or its configuration has since changed. Create a new version with the current project, keeping the design content, then review and confirm it.
confirm.ignoreHint: Continue confirming with unresolved questions. They will remain unresolved. Future delivery will use this version; you can start delivery after confirmation.
confirm.questionsGuide: Answer each question or explain what is out of scope. Send your answers to update the design, adopt the result after previewing it, then confirm the version.
confirm.title: Confirm design version
confirm.blockedHint: Blocking questions are still unresolved or unexcluded ({{count}}). Handle them before confirming.
confirm.modeLegacy: Original delivery path (does not change the existing flow)
confirm.noTargetHint: PRD-driven delivery needs a valid target frontend project first; without one you can only confirm on the original path.
confirm.immutableHint: Confirming records that you accept the exact content of this version; a confirmed version cannot be modified, and editing creates a new draft. Confirming does not automatically trigger coding, merge or release.

acceptance.progress: Passed {{passed}} / Failed {{failed}} / Not verified {{notVerified}} / Not applicable {{notApplicable}} (total {{total}})
acceptance.incompleteHint: An unverified requirement is not counted as passed; wait for the executor report or check why it is blocked.
acceptance.excludedByDesign: The confirmed design excluded this requirement from this delivery round

verdict.notVerifiedHint: Not verified yet; not counted as passed

renderer.blockingHint: Blocking questions must be resolved or explicitly excluded before confirming.
